lastCompletedStory.title: Pin CI bun via bun-version-file and enforce it in ci-parity

nextStoryContext: US-002 added `with: bun-version-file: .bun-version` to the oven-sh/setup-bun@v2 step in .github/workflows/ci.yml (no floating bun-version: latest anywhere). scripts/check-ci-parity.ts gained a new exported function checkBunVersionPin(workflowYaml, pinnedBunVersion) that: (1) fails if pinnedBunVersion is null (i.e. .bun-version is absent/malformed per readPinnedBunVersion from src/config/toolchain.ts, US-001), (2) fails if no oven-sh/setup-bun step exists in any job, (3) fails if the step's with.bun-version-file !== '.bun-version', (4) fails if the step also sets a floating with.bun-version (e.g. 'latest'). checkParityFromFile now merges checkParity's errors with checkBunVersionPin's errors (reading the real .bun-version via readPinnedBunVersion()); checkParity itself is UNCHANGED (still takes only workflowYaml+gates, so the pre-existing aligned/unknown-script/missing-gate fixtures -- which have no setup-bun step -- still pass through checkParity alone). New fixtures added under test/fixtures/: bun-pin-aligned.yml (passing shape), bun-pin-missing.yml (setup-bun step present, no bun-version-file), bun-pin-floating.yml (bun-version: latest set), bun-pin-no-step.yml (no setup-bun step at all). Also raised scripts/file-size-budget.json ceilings for scripts/check-ci-parity.ts (176->290) and test/check-ci-parity.test.ts (172->250) with a CAM-201 tracker ref staged in the same commit (ratchet gate convention, patterns.md). US-003 (worker Dockerfile toolchain) should read readPinnedBunVersion/readPinnedNodeVersion from src/config/toolchain.ts directly to build the Docker build-arg, mirroring how checkBunVersionPin consumes the same reader here, rather than re-parsing .bun-version/.tool-versions or grepping ci.yml.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed bun-version-file is a supported input on setup-bun@v2 that reads the pinned version from a file (e.g. .bun-version); without an explicit bun-version or bun-version-file input the action falls back through package.json packageManager/engines.bun and finally to 'latest'. Our ci.yml change (adding bun-version-file: .bun-version) matches the documented API and eliminates the prior implicit 'latest' float.
